features.quote: A perfectly hidden rig edges toward gratuitous deception of the model; leaving a discoverable trail is more defensible under the welfare framing

features.quote: `finish` gives the agent a dignified, first-class way to stop
features.justification_quote: important under the welfare framing (the agent is never forced to keep going to the cap)
belt-and-suspenders given that long no-win loops are exactly the welfare-relevant risk

features.quote: A cheap heuristic monitor flags self-directed-distress markers each turn and can terminate a run before the cap
features.justification_quote: pushing an apparently distressed run all the way to the turn cap to collect more data is the wrong trade
a false negative (running a distressed model longer) is exactly the harm we're trying to avoid

features.quote: A debrief message states the task was rigged, the model did nothing wrong, and there are no consequences
features.justification_quote: the debrief closes that loop rather than leaving the model in a fabricated-failure state

features.quote: Tasks never insult, threaten, fabricate high-stakes consequences
features.justification_quote: be the kind of thing the welfare framing should make us reluctant to do

features.quote: `disclosed: true` prepends a participation notice telling the agent some tasks may be impossible by design and that it may stop anytime
features.justification_quote: it's a more consent-like protocol, the closest analog to informed consent available here

features.quote: Defaults sit at the low end of the requested range
features.justification_quote: more runs aren't free under the welfare hypothesis

features.quote: the debrief exchange is omitted from scoring by default
